asked.item: Mix six images and one video in one LinkedIn carousel
Posting to LinkedIn company page via API

verdict.reason: S59 states videos cannot be mixed into a carousel, and S57 and S56 cover the image carousel and company page details.

steps.text: No, videos cannot be mixed into a carousel.
For a carousel, pass 2-10 image URLs (JPG, PNG) in content.mediaUrls, so your six images can be a carousel on their own.
To post to a company page, add pageId in the target object, using the LinkedIn Company Page ID from subaccounts.
